top_stories.title: Coinbase Receives Federal Trust Bank Charter
points: Coinbase obtained final Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) approval for a national trust bank charter, a federal designation letting it operate custody and other banking-like services under U.S. regulatory oversight.
This joins Coinbase's existing 2018 New York trust charter and puts it alongside Circle and Ripple in moving crypto custody businesses under federal regulation.
The charter enables Coinbase to offer broader financial services beyond crypto trading, seen as mainstream institutional acceptance of crypto infrastructure.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Investigation and Market Impact
points: A U.S. government memo alleged CEO Jensen Huang was romantically involved with an executive at Nvidia customer Megaspeed, whom U.S. intelligence believes was recruited by China's spy agency.

Nvidia's board launched an independent investigation and stated it has 'no reason to believe' national security or company secrets were compromised; Huang apologized for infidelity to his wife and pledged full cooperation.

Nvidia stock fell 4.7% to $177.80 on Monday (a roughly 5% drop), breaking below key support levels; Decrypt's prediction market puts 69% odds on shares hitting $168 before month's end, ahead of November 17 earnings.
Bipartisan lawmakers are demanding answers from both Nvidia and federal intelligence agencies about security implications and what was disclosed.

items.title: NYSE Taps Avalanche for Tokenized Securities
points: The New York Stock Exchange selected Avalanche, a blockchain network (a distributed ledger that processes transactions), to power its forthcoming tokenized securities platform.
This marks a major institutional use case for blockchain infrastructure, following years of industry advocacy for clearer frameworks.

items.title: Ethereum's Repositioning and AI Payment Innovation
points: Vitalik Buterin moved away from the 'ultrasound money' framing (the idea that Ethereum burns fees to create deflationary value), now emphasizing decentralization, censorship resistance, and security as ETH's core value.
Tom Lee's Bitmine extended its weekly Ethereum buying streak, adding 9,587 ETH worth about $20 million, signaling institutional conviction in ETH's long-term fundamentals.

Coinbase launched the x402 protocol, reviving the dormant HTTP 402 status code to let AI agents and applications pay for APIs and data directly in stablecoins like USDC (a dollar-linked digital currency), enabling machine-to-machine crypto payments.

items.title: Political and Compliance Developments
points: Former President Trump said he knows 'nothing' about World Liberty Financial, the family crypto venture, claiming his sons run it and that presidential conflicts of interest are unavoidable; he defended UAE ties when pressed on divestment.

Microsoft-backed Space and Time launched an enterprise platform using Proof of SQL (a cryptographic method to verify calculations on private data without exposing the underlying records), letting AI agents verify private business data while maintaining confidentiality.

items.title: Strategy's Bitcoin Purchase
points: Strategy, Michael Saylor's company, acquired 1,036 BTC valued at approximately $77 million.
The purchase continues the firm's aggressive, ongoing Bitcoin accumulation strategy, signaling continued corporate confidence despite market volatility.
